metadata.name: Kingdom of David & Solomon
metadata.description: Approximate boundaries of the United Kingdom under David and Solomon (~1010–931 BC)

properties.name: Kingdom of David & Solomon
properties.description: At its greatest extent under Solomon, the kingdom stretched from the Euphrates in the north to the border of Egypt in the south, fulfilling God's promise to Abraham.

properties.name: Jerusalem (Capital)
properties.description: David captured the Jebusite stronghold of Jerusalem and made it his capital, calling it the City of David.

properties.name: Gibeon
properties.description: At Gibeon God appeared to Solomon in a dream and offered him anything. Solomon asked for wisdom; God gave him wisdom and also riches and honor.

properties.name: Megiddo
properties.description: Solomon rebuilt Megiddo as a strategic fortified city, one of his great building projects alongside Jerusalem and Gezer.
